prompt: Setting up the Meta lead-gen campaign for a few trades. How to structure campaign+ad sets, what naming convention, and when to kill vs scale a creative? Target CPL ~$25.

assertions.text: Recommends Leads objective + ad sets split by trade vertical
Kill rule tied to a multiple of target CPL (~2.5x = $62.50) AND a min-spend threshold (~2x = $50)
Mentions learning phase (~50 conversions/week per ad set)
Scale winners by duplication / never edit a live winner
Mentions statistical significance (min ~100 clicks or CI overlap)
